label: main season
summary: Recommend further non-technical survey. The evidence log contains no direct or target indirect evidence of explosive ordnance, but cancellation criteria are not met: only the woodcutter reports at least five years of first-hand safe use (19 years); the teacher reports three years, and the community-board president's report covers four years and is not clearly first-hand. The team could not see the area interior on visit 1. Further evidence is needed before release can be recommended.
flags: Visit 1 reached only the edge and could not see the land inside; cancellation therefore relies on informant reports.
Zone flag and survey priority guide where to visit and are not evidence about contamination.

checks.detail: Further non-technical survey is always open.

E1.quote: The president of the community action board (Junta de Acción Comunal) said the board has recorded no find or accident in the area in the 4 years she has held the post, and that families use land in the area every week.
E1.note: Reports no recorded find or accident and regular use, but she is not identified as a land user or as having personally observed all use; treat as second-hand for the absence claim.

E2.quote: The survey team could reach only the edge of the area, because rain had closed the trail into it, and could not see the land inside.
E2.note: This documents a limitation on survey coverage, not presence or absence inside the area.

E3.quote: We have cut firewood and timber here for 19 years. Nobody has found anything, and nobody has been hurt.
E3.note: The woodcutter describes his own 19 years of work in the area without finds or injuries, a first-hand report supporting safe use.

E4.quote: A teacher said she has walked the trail across the area to the school every year for the past 3 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E4.note: The teacher gives first-hand evidence of her own regular use without finding anything, though the reported period is only 3 years.
